item: build tools/gen_worldgen_spheres.py emitting Worldgen.luau's 130 hand-folded spheres from corpus/df_mine/df_spheres.json, same pattern as tools/gen_artifact_lore.py (t26's next_steal)
note: Landed tools/gen_worldgen_spheres.py on the t26 house pattern: the 130 canonical sphere names in folded emission order live in the generator as the curated pool identity with provenance (order equals the mine's canonical order), while every name is joined from df_spheres.json (spheres key) at generate time; each key must appear exactly once in the mine or the generator dies. Probe found 130/130 grounded, 0 curated fallback constants needed. Splice wraps the SPHERES block in new BEGIN/END GENERATED markers (do-not-hand-edit header + regenerate command), CRLF preserved, byte-identical on rerun. Two splice defects hit and fixed on the way: (1) END marker glued onto Worldgen.SPHERES = SPHERES (nil export), independently caught mid-lane by t35 through ZoneGate.luau, which patched the tool to emit a trailing newline; (2) t41's conditional eol append then COMPOUNDED with t35's fix into +1 eol per rerun (sandbox census 2->3->4). Reconciled to one convention: region carries its own terminator, markers path consumes the one that follows END. Final production runs are from the restored pristine file (sha b936de7e verified). Verdicts: rerun byte-identical; structural diff pre vs post = exactly the 3 marker lines; entry-line sha256 ba98d831... identical pre/post (130 rows); EOL census +3 CRLF / 0 rewrites; luau_lint check() on Worldgen.luau NONE (clean), full tree = 3 pre-existing zones_extra findings untouched. mountain_check NOT run (shared). roblox/src/the_mountain.rbxlx embedded copy not rebuilt (gate owns rebuilds).
